description: Thirty-one monthly-publication packages cover 1994 and 1996–2025. They describe a weighted average field price from Alberta gas sales surveys used in royalty valuation. The inspected PDF descriptors omit 1995, list only October–December in 2002, omit September 2010, and stop at August in 2025. Other listed years contain twelve monthly descriptors, without verification of file contents. A companion Alberta Official Statistic supplies a CSV series labelled 2007–April 2016 and a PDF visualisation; its description defines an average gas-plant price from Alberta Market Hub purchases on NGX. It states that In-Stream Component prices replaced the reference price as the main Crown royalty valuation method in October 2002, while the reference price continued in ISC calculations and default valuations. Both methodologies and coverage limits are retained within this curated royalty-price family. They are not asserted to be numerically equivalent to each other or to general market-price data. Geographic coverage is Alberta. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source identifiers and descriptive metadata. The native licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual payload access and costs remain unverified. No linked dataset, workbook, document, legal text, model or code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond those explicitly described are not established.
